test_title: PYST 02: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 05 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: One pipe can fill the tank in 10 minutes while another pipe can empty completely filled tank in 20 minutes. If both the pipes are operated together on empty tank, how long (in minutes) will it take to fill the tank completely?
solution:
**Given:**

Pipe A fill time = 10 min, Pipe B empty time = 20 min

Calculations:

Total work = LCM(10,20) = 20 units

Efficiency = work/time

⇒ A = 20/10 = 2 units/min

⇒ Efficiency of B = 20/20 = 1 unit/min (empty ⇒ –1)

⇒ Net = 2 – 1 = 1 unit/min

⇒ Time = 20/1 = 20 min

**∴ Time to fill tank = 20 minutes.**
